description: One Bodega prediction market by its id: the question, current YES and NO probability (percent), shares outstanding per side, funds in the market, volume, deadline, outcome, how the YES probability moved (first, lowest, highest, latest and the last points of its history) and the most recent buys, sales and claims with what was paid per share. Get the id from `list_prediction_markets`. Trading is not done here: `tradeUrl` is the market on Bodega.

marketId.description: Market id as `list_prediction_markets` returns it, e.g. "FC1B_BTC_REACHES_9000".

name: get_prediction_market
title: One prediction market
